frame._note: This section adds the device frame around the app screenshot. You can choose between 'android', 'ios' for the type, and specify the cutout style 'pill', 'punch-hole' or 'none'.

fonts._note: To change the fonts, just replace the font names below with any Google Fonts of your choice.
fonts.heading: Montserrat

palette._note: You can customize the color palette for your app. The primary color is used for buttons and highlights, accent color for secondary actions, and surface color for backgrounds. Try https://color.adobe.com/ to generate a palette.

hero._note: This is the hero section of your app landing page. You can customize the title, subtitle, main text, and screenshot image.
hero.subtitle: Your app subtitle goes here.
hero.title: This is the Main Title.
hero.mainText: This is the main text of the hero section. It can be a brief description or tagline for your app.

stores._note: Make sure to change links below to your app links. Customize the app store badges for iOS and Android - grab the name and path for the appropriate badges from the images/ folder, i.e.'images/app store badges/Download_on_the_App_Store_Badge_FR_RGB_blk_100517.svg' for French.
stores.heading: Download for iOS & Android

_note: 'sections' is the alternating rows content section of your app landing page. You can add multiple sections with headlines, text, images, and links. It will adjust to landscape or portrait images and also handle empty URLs if you want to just give info, not a link on one section.

sections.headline: Real-time sync across all your devices
sections.text: Your notes, tasks, and habits stay in perfect synchronization. Cloud-first architecture ensures instant availability everywhere you go.

sections.headline: Distraction-free clarity with thoughtful design
sections.text: Every pixel is placed with intention. Enjoy high-contrast legibility, calm color tones, and tactile responsive controls that respect your focus.

sections.headline: Offline-ready with robust local persistence
sections.text: Stay productive even without an active internet connection. Work uninterrupted on planes, subways, or remote spots with instant local caching.
